Conditions

Try this path

As a visitor: Find, tap a popular route, open the first ride (watch the route draw in and the request snap onto it), request a seat, sign in, finish the profile, send the request (the launch moment). Then open the demo controls and choose Driver accepts, then 07:15 ride day (live trip), Another passenger joins (the price drops), then 09:40 after the ride, and rate the driver. As Andrei: Offer a ride to pick seats and publish, or My rides, Driving, to answer requests. Flip Reduce motion or Light to see the still and light versions.
